title: audio_db playlist fns return raw tuples
description:
In fieldwork-db/src/audio_db.rs, playlist-related functions return raw tuples instead of typed structs:
- get_audio_playlist returns Option<(i64, i64, String, String, String, i64)> (line 728)
- list_audio_playlists returns Vec<(i64, i64, String, String, String, i64)> (line 759)
- list_user_audio_playlists returns Vec<(i64, String, String, i64)> (line 793)

This forces callers (smallhold, gaja, broadside funkwhale_api.rs) to destructure via positional indexes (pl.0, pl.1, etc.), making the code fragile and unreadable. Every other entity in the db layer has a named row struct (TrackRow, AudioChannelRow, BookRow, etc.).

The same positional tuple destructuring appears in 3 server handlers that build PlaylistResponse from the 6-element tuple, and tests that assert on pl.0 through pl.5 (audio_db tests line 1559-1564).

Fix: add an AudioPlaylistRow struct consistent with the other row types.
